$comment: What a leadgen delivery's VALUE object carries -- ids and a timestamp, and no answers at all. Reproduced exactly, because the whole point of this shape is that an author must discover on the canvas that the data needs a second call, rather than wiring {{ $json.email }} against a fake that helpfully invented one.

values.$comment: Drawn ONCE and bound before the response, so the id a flow reads here is the id it would pass to lead_get. Two independent draws would produce a delivery no dedupe could match against itself.
